generator_cmd: node -e "const fw=s=>[...s].map(c=>c===' '?'\u3000':String.fromCharCode(c.charCodeAt(0)+0xFEE0)).join('');process.stdout.write(fw('Nice work'))" | iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-16LE | xxd -p | tr -d '\n' | sed 's/../\\x&/g'  # \xHH escapes of the UTF-16LE bytes of fullwidth text (2e ff ..): not UTF-8
oracle_cmd: printf '%b' "$encoded" | iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8  # glibc iconv: illegal UTF-8 -> no multibyte reading
